questions.question: When two power-driven vessels are meeting on reciprocal courses with risk of collision, what action is generally required?
questions.explanation: COLREG Rule 14: each vessel should alter course to starboard to pass port-to-port.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: In restricted visibility, which action is generally appropriate when radar detects another vessel and risk of collision exists?
options: Make an early avoiding action in accordance with Rule 19
Switch off radar to reduce clutter
questions.explanation: COLREG Rule 19 requires safe speed and appropriate avoiding action; assess the specific encounter.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: What is the primary responsibility of an officer keeping a navigational watch?
questions.explanation: STCW watchkeeping principles require a safe navigational watch.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: What does a charted depth ordinarily refer to?
options: Depth above mean sea level in all charts
questions.explanation: Charted depths are referenced to the chart datum stated on the chart.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: What should an engineer do when an abnormal machinery alarm occurs?
options: Assess and respond according to approved procedures
Wait until the next watch regardless
questions.explanation: Watchkeepers must investigate and respond appropriately to alarms under approved procedures.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: What is the appropriate response to a suspected oil discharge incident?
options: Follow the vessel SOPEP and reporting procedures
Discharge more water to dilute oil
Erase the oil record book entry
Wait until arriving at the next port
questions.explanation: Follow the shipboard oil pollution emergency plan and applicable reporting requirements.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: Why is lubricating oil pressure monitored on operating machinery?
questions.explanation: Low lubrication pressure can indicate conditions that risk machinery damage.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)

questions.question: Before entering an enclosed space, what must be done?
options: Follow the enclosed-space entry permit and atmospheric testing procedure
Enter alone for a quick inspection
Rely on smell to check oxygen
questions.explanation: Enclosed-space entry requires risk assessment, atmosphere checks, permits, and safeguards per approved procedures.
questions.source: Toolbox original practice (not an official MARINA question)
